title: VTC Join-Requests Wallet Session Start — payload
description: An applicant asks the community to open an OpenID4VP 1.0 presentation session for one of its join criteria, so that a wallet which cannot sign Trust Tasks can present credentials as evidence for the applicant's join. The applicant is the document proof's signer, not a payload member. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

criterion.description: The `requirementsDigest` of the criterion the applicant is gathering evidence for, as vtc/join-requests/manifest/0.3 published it — the same value vtc/join-requests/submit/0.3 carries as its `criterion`. Naming the version, not only the criterion, fixes the DCQL query the wallet is asked to satisfy to the one the applicant read.

requestId.description: An existing join request of the applicant's to record the evidence on. Absent: the community holds the evidence, for a bounded period of its own policy, for the applicant's next vtc/join-requests/submit under the same criterion.

clientIdPrefix.description: The OpenID4VP 1.0 client identifier prefix the community should identify itself to the wallet with — a DID (`decentralized_identifier`, as swiyu wallets expect) or an X.509 certificate (`x509_hash`, as EUDI wallets expect). Values are OpenID4VP's own and are carried verbatim. Absent: the community's default. A community holding no verifier identity of the requested kind refuses with `verifierNotConfigured`.

Response.title: VTC Join-Requests Wallet Session Start — response payload

sessionId.description: Opaque, unguessable identifier of the session, carrying at least 128 bits of entropy. The applicant reads the outcome with vtc/join-requests/wallet-session/status under it.

walletUri.description: The OpenID4VP invocation URI for this session, carrying `client_id` and `request_uri`, to be rendered as a QR code or opened as a deep link. Its scheme is the community's choice for the wallet ecosystem it serves — `openid4vp://`, `swiyu-verify://`, `haip-vp://` and others.

clientId.description: The full OpenID4VP client identifier the community presents to the wallet, prefix included (`decentralized_identifier:did:webvh:…`, `x509_hash:…`). It is the audience the wallet's key-binding JWT will name.

dcqlQuery.description: The DCQL query (OpenID4VP 1.0 §6) the wallet will be asked to satisfy: the criterion's published query, unchanged. Opaque here; its members are DCQL's own and keep DCQL's snake_case names.

expiresAt.description: When the session closes if no wallet has answered it. Minutes, not hours.
